title: EdictDef
description: A regional edict — one of decision 1's five web verbs (docs/design-decisions.md). Enacted at a settlement, it stamps an additive modifier into one viability channel across a radius. Everything an edict does enters the sim through ModifierLayer; it never gets a bespoke rule of its own.

cost.description: One-time gold cost to enact. Must be positive — a free edict is a strictly-dominant choice and the linter rejects it.

upkeepPerTurn.description: Gold charged per turn while active. May be negative: that is how tax-pressure nets revenue.

channel.description: Must name a known ViabilityChannel. Enforced by the linter as well as here, because content is loaded by the sim without a JSON-schema validator in the loop.
